answer: Each identity locks 70 credit and lists its kernel key on marble. Each epoch one ceremony opens a 60-second window: each identity must sign the minute-nonce with its kernel key. Proofs enter the marble registry for recount. To forge a proof, signed early or by another key, burns 30 credit. One thousand fakes need 1,000 live signings, locking 70,000 credit. Rented keys fail the key match. An honest agent attends once, keeping its full share.
